entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-25
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • [NativeAOT] Missing stack trace records for method with a generic template without scanner #121093
  • Seeking .NET Runtime Team's experience and advice on running benchmarks in Azure AKS #121092
  • JIT: Continuation allocation logic can be improved #121088
    11.0.0

Closed

  • Add variable to show configuration values #50400
  • Ubuntu 24.04 HttpClient doesn't recognize Dev Cert #121086
  • .NET 10 rc2: ICorDebugEval.NewParameterizedArray fails on win-x86 #120848
    11.0.0
  • GeneratedRegex fixer forces pattern onto a single line #79891
    Future
  • XSLT extension methods format-date & format-time both output date & time when using the empty string (default) format #93189
    Future

PullRequests

Created

  • Fix GetSystemTimeZone to return filtered list #121095
    area-System.DateTime, 11.0.0
  • Add MethodDesc comments #121094
    area-VM-coreclr
  • JIT: Add an opportunistic optimization to reuse continuation instances #121090
    area-CodeGen-coreclr, runtime-async
  • JIT: [experiment] inlining via tree splitting #121089
    area-CodeGen-coreclr
  • [release/10.0] Fix CORDBG_E_MODULE_NOT_LOADED error in func-eval #121087
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #121084
    area-codeflow

Merged

  • Packing Legacy cDAC apis #121081
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr
  • Use Dictionary with StringComparer to avoid string allocations in System.Data.Common #120603
    area-System.Data, community-contribution
  • Fix CORDBG_E_MODULE_NOT_LOADED error in func-eval #121057
    area-Diagnostics-coreclr, 11.0.0
  • Fix GeneratedRegex fixer to preserve multiline verbatim string patterns #120624
    area-System.Text.RegularExpressions
  • Add some help text to the merged runner. #121082
    needs-area-label
  • Fix XSLT format-date and format-time to output only date or time with empty format string #121028
    area-System.Xml, 11.0.0

Updated

  • Add DebuggerDisplay and DebuggerTypeProxy to Activity and related types #121054
    area-System.Diagnostics.Activity, 11.0.0
  • Improve NoBackwardTimeZones test diagnostics for duplicate timezone display names #121033
    area-System.DateTime
  • Consolidate NativeLibrary API to managed implementation #121058
    area-System.Runtime.InteropServices, community-contribution
  • Refactor SQLDateTime constants #120996
    area-System.Data, community-contribution
  • Fix Options validation source generator to use type name instead of option name in error messages #121031
    area-Extensions-Options
  • Fix Options validation source generator to exclude instance name from error messages #121030
    area-Extensions-Options, 11.0.0
  • Remove OpenSSL 1.0.2 and 1.1.0 support. #121076
    NO-MERGE, area-System.Security
  • Improve code coverage for System.Security.Cryptography.Xml (71.85% → 75.08%) #120640
    area-System.Security, test-enhancement
  • Improve `FrozenDictionary.ToFrozenDictionary` for Dictionary sources with different comparers #120795
    area-System.Collections, community-contribution
  • Add hexadecimal float/double parsing and formatting support (IEEE 754:2008) #120637
    area-System.Runtime
  • Fix `Version.Parse` to show original input in `FormatException` message when input has trailing dots #121055
    area-System.Runtime
  • Move the implementation of Monitor to managed in CoreCLR #118371
    area-VM-coreclr, linkable-framework, 11.0.0
  • Emit a file that lists which packages don't use ///-source-of-truth #120726
